description: A single square of high-powered blotter acid, printed with a grinning sun.

events.text: [trip]A cold electric tingle climbs your spine and the edges of everything start to breathe.[/trip]
[trip]Colours are getting louder. The light has opinions now.[/trip]
[trip]The room inhales and the walls flow outward into cathedral vaults of liquid light.[/trip]
[trip]Fractal vines of every impossible colour crawl up from the floor and flower midair.[/trip]
[trip]Your own hands leave glowing trails, a hundred hands fanning out from your wrists.[/trip]
[trip]Sound has texture. A distant machine hum is velvet dragged across your teeth.[/trip]
[trip]You are absolutely certain, for one perfect second, that you understand it all.[/trip]
[trip]A stranger who is also you steps out of the wall, waves, and folds back in.[/trip]
[trip]The grinning sun from the tab is still on the ceiling, but it's tired now, and so are you.[/trip]
[trip]The fractals fold themselves away one by one, leaving the walls plain and faintly glowing.[/trip]
[trip]You're mostly back. Everything is very slightly too meaningful, and will be for a while.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: The paper was not a lie. The walls take their first slow breath.

phases.comedown_message: The peak loosens its grip. The world starts remembering how to be ordinary.
phases.comeup_message: Your jaw tightens, your feet won't quite hold still, and the room shimmers at the edges.
phases.end_message: You're down — wrung-out and wide awake, thoughts still trailing colour.
phases.peak_message: The come-up crests and breaks. You are all the way in it now.

effects.take_line: You lay the square of {name} on your tongue and wait.

name: blotter
